$description: Named styles: one setting that reshapes every component (corners, size, surfaces, shadows and type). scripts/build.mjs turns these into [data-style] rules in dist/themes.css; scripts/build-native.mjs into the Native `style` setting. The font, density and corners dials still override a style. radius: xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl in px. card: outline | flat | filled | elevated. controls: rounded | pill | square. shadows: soft | none. font: a font vibe from src/font-themes.css.
